name: words convert --to openxps with an --out of another extension, or none, says in a sentence that reads for any format name that the output needs the .oxps extension, and writes nothing; the .oxps output converts

json.equals: --to openxps contradicts --out 'contract.openxps': its .openxps extension is not an extension of openxps. Must be one of: .oxps.
--to openxps contradicts --out 'contract': it has no extension, and an output in openxps needs one. Must be one of: .oxps.
